subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should OpenClaw move the iPhone Control tab from the current native List direction to this card-based Chat/Talk redesign?
rationale: The change is visual/product direction rather than a bug fix, the linked issue is explicitly marked for maintainer/product review, and newer merged iOS work moved the same surface toward native SwiftUI lists.

options.title: Pause pending rebase and proof
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main, preserve the native iOS navigation improvements, fix scoped typography issues, and provide before/after simulator proof before design approval.

options.title: Close in favor of current native direction
options.body: If maintainers prefer the native List/Form direction from the merged iOS redesign work, close this PR and the linked feature request with that rationale.

options.title: Sponsor the card redesign
options.body: A maintainer can adopt the direction and request a focused reworked branch that intentionally replaces the current Control tab visual model.

recommendation.title: Pause pending rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main, preserve the native iOS navigation improvements, fix scoped typography issues, and provide before/after simulator proof before design approval.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the recent merged Control/Talk visual hierarchy PR with proof and is the strongest product/design routing candidate from the related history.
